title: Chuck E. Cheese's
blurb: Chuck E. Cheese Inverness offers arcade games, pizza, and birthday party packages including gameplay, live shows, and prizes. The location features a new Adventure Zone with trampolines and an obstacle course. Safety is emphasized with a Kid Check® program ensuring children leave only with their designated adults.
